name: Runner Extras - reports with more than one data item
brief: Pins that a report with sibling and nested data items over the Integer virtual table emits rows for every one of them.
description: dataitem(X; Integer) with a DataItemTableView filter is the standard idiom for a synthetic report dataset — 28 of Pageworks' 29 test reports use it. This suite pins that sibling and nested data items each emit their own rows, asserted through SaveAs(Xml) so a failure points at a missing dataset ROW rather than at rendering. Written while investigating a cluster of Pageworks reports that render zero pages, where the number of data items correlated exactly with the failures; these tests EXONERATE that layer (all three pass), so the cluster's cause lies elsewhere. They are kept as a regression guard for an idiom almost every report dataset depends on.
